name: PdxFormField
description:
Layout wrapper for one form control: label, the slotted input, hint and error, with the ARIA
wiring between them and no validation of its own.

members.name: field
members.description:
The form field this field shows (#128): `:field="f.email"`. Its error, warning, touched state and
required-ness, with no `name` and no surrounding `<pdx-form>`.

members.name: name
members.description: Field name — if set and inside <pdx-form>, auto-wires error/touched from form context.

members.name: hint
members.description: Helper text shown under the control.

members.name: error
members.description:
The error message. Shown only when the field is touched, when `show-error` is set, or when
its form validates onChange: an error decided by code (a server rejection, a check on save)
goes with `show-error`.

members.name: required
members.description:
Marks the field required: `aria-required` on its control and the required marker on its
label. Not needed for a field the form requires — one whose validators include
`required()` is marked the same way without it.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: touched
members.description: Whether the field has been interacted with (gates validation display).

members.name: showError
members.description: Force error display even if not touched

members.name: horizontal
members.description: Horizontal layout: label left, input right

members.name: a11yLabel
members.description:
The control's name when the field shows no `label`: set as its aria-label. A visible label
wins, and a control that names itself keeps its own name.

members.name: size
members.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl.

cssStates.description: `required`: required by its prop or by its form; the label carries the marker (`--pdx-field-required-marker`).

cssStates.name: optional

cssStates.name: disabled

cssStates.name: invalid
cssStates.description: `invalid`: its error is shown; the control is aria-invalid and described by it.

cssStates.name: success
cssStates.description: `success`: its success message is shown, and no error or warning.
